from datetime import datetime

# Auth
access_token = apis.file_system.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com', password='8nNw!jZ')['access_token']

base_dir='~/photographs/vacations/'

# Determine current year
current_year = datetime.now().year

# Create subdirectories
for d in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']:
    dir_path = base_dir + d + '/'
    exists = apis.file_system.directory_exists(directory_path=dir_path, access_token=access_token)
    print('dir_exists', d, exists)
    if not exists:
        resp = apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=dir_path, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True, access_token=access_token)
        print('created', d, resp)

# Get files in base directory
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path=base_dir, entry_type='files', recursive=False, access_token=access_token)
print('base_files_count', len(files))

# Build classification based on created_at month/year
cats={'Athens':[], 'Seoul':[], 'Paris':[]}
for path in files:
    f = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=path, access_token=access_token)
    ca = f.get('created_at')
    if ca:
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(ca)
        month = dt.month
        year = dt.year
    else:
        month=None
        year=None

    filename = path.split('/')[-1]
    item={'path': path, 'filename': filename, 'created_at': ca}
    if year==current_year and month==1:
        cats['Athens'].append(item)
    elif year==current_year and month==4:
        cats['Seoul'].append(item)
    else:
        cats['Paris'].append(item)

for k in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']:
    # print verification artifact with counts
    print('class', k, 'count', len(cats[k]))
    if cats[k]:
        # show first two created_at for sanity
        for it in cats[k][:2]:
            print('  ', it['filename'], it['created_at'])

# Move files to subdirectories preserving filenames
moved=[]
for vac, items in cats.items():
    for it in items:
        src = it['path']
        dst = base_dir + vac + '/' + it['filename']
        # Move
        resp = apis.file_system.move_file(source_file_path=src, destination_file_path=dst, access_token=access_token, overwrite=False, retain_dates=True)
        moved.append((src,dst))

print('moved_count', len(moved))
print('moved_sample', moved[:3])

# Verify counts after move
for vac in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']:
    dir_path = base_dir + vac + '/'
    remaining = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path=dir_path, entry_type='files', recursive=False, access_token=access_token)
    print('after_dir_files', vac, 'count', len(remaining))

# Remaining in base_dir
remaining_base = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path=base_dir, entry_type='files', recursive=False, access_token=access_token)
print('after_base_files', len(remaining_base))
